STEP 1 - Scene: mixed salad with grain bowl, lunch/dinner plate (photo rotated 90°)
STEP 2 - Vessel: white square plate ~26 cm; area 3.14 x 13^2 = 530 cm^2
STEP 3 - Items: mixed leaves, brown rice/grain mix, baked tofu cubes, broccoli, cucumber slice, crumbled feta
STEP 4 - Area: leaves 35%, grains 17%, tofu 5%, broccoli 3%, cucumber 2%, feta 1% = 63% covered
STEP 5 - Volume:
- leaves 186 cm^2 x 3 cm = 556 ml
- grains 90 cm^2 x 2 cm = 180 ml
- tofu 26.5 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 40 ml
- broccoli 16 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 24 ml
- cucumber 10.6 cm^2 x 0.8 cm = 8.5 ml
- feta 5 cm^2 x 0.5 cm = 2.5 ml
STEP 6 - Grams:
- leaves 556 ml x 0.15 = 83 g
- grains 180 ml x 0.8 = 144 g
- tofu 40 ml x 0.95 = 38 g
- broccoli 24 ml x 0.6 = 14 g
- cucumber 8.5 ml x 0.6 = 5 g
- feta 2.5 ml x 0.95 = 2 g
- total = 286 g
STEP 7 - Energy:
- leaves 83 g x 25/100 = 21 kcal
- grains 144 g x 115/100 = 166 kcal
- tofu 38 g x 145/100 = 55 kcal
- broccoli 14 g x 34/100 = 5 kcal
- cucumber 5 g x 15/100 = 1 kcal
- feta 2 g x 264/100 = 6 kcal
- total = 254 kcal
STEP 8 - Sanity check: 286 g and 254 kcal fit a partly covered dinner plate of salad and grain bowl with no visible oil or dressing pool.
